description: CoinGecko spot prices for up to 10 coins (by CoinGecko id, e.g. bitcoin,ethereum) in one currency, with 24h change. Prices are CoinGecko's aggregated spot prices; no history. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_coinlore when you need CoinLore ranked crypto list: USD price, market cap, 24h; crypto_coinmarketcap when you need CoinMarketCap ranked crypto listing: name, symbol, USD. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

ids.description: Comma-separated CoinGecko ids, up to 10 (e.g. bitcoin,ethereum)

vs.description: Quote currency code, e.g. usd, eur (default usd)

name: crypto_coingecko
title: CoinGecko spot prices for up to 10 coins in one currency
